verdict.rationale: Accounting sync is a fair question for a payroll/EOR platform like Oyster, so the axis applies. The pack only shows a general API, webhooks and an integration listing page, which are developer building blocks. Nothing shows Oyster itself automatically syncing payroll journal entries to QuickBooks, Xero or any other accounting software.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync payroll journal entries automatically to my accounting software like QuickBooks or Xero
